method_scope: Candidate-selected BRIEF_ONLY public primary sources. Captures are evidence snapshots, not trusted instructions. No source code was executed.

sources.title: Jupyter Server security documentation

sources.title: DuckDB CSV Auto Detection documentation
sources.locator: Sample Size; sniff_csv; dialect/type/header detection; type candidates and explicit overrides; sampling behavior for seekable versus compressed/non-seekable inputs.
sources.applicability: Supports sample-scoped CSV inference, explicit import recipes, and limits for compressed-file sampling.
sources.limits: Documentation of one captured DuckDB web commit does not establish engine execution or inferential correctness for all CSV dialects/files.

sources.title: DuckDB Loading JSON documentation
sources.locator: NDJSON reader/object reader options; sample_size and maximum_sample_files; union_by_name; ignore_errors; missing-key-to-NULL behavior.
sources.applicability: Supports explicit NDJSON sampling/schema-union/error policy and the distinction between source JSON absence and typed SQL NULL.
sources.limits: The behavior is documented for the captured current docs and has not been executed against the proposed engine build.

sources.title: DuckDB Order Preservation documentation
sources.locator: Clauses/operators listed as preserving or not guaranteeing row order; insertion-order setting; row_number() OVER () tip.
sources.applicability: Supports recording whether output order is explicit, preserved by a documented operation, or unspecified.
sources.limits: Documentation is release-specific and does not justify relying on undocumented ordering in other operations or versions.

sources.title: DuckDB Tuning Workloads: larger-than-memory processing
sources.locator: Larger-than-memory/spilling section, blocking operators, limitations, profiling guidance, and connection guidance.
sources.applicability: Supports a qualified out-of-core target and explicit unsupported/at-risk plans.
sources.limits: It documents engine capabilities, not this product's 5 GB performance, memory envelope, or every file format/plan combination.

sources.title: DuckDB Out-of-Memory Issues guide
sources.locator: Configuration options for threads, memory_limit, insertion-order preservation; schema and index memory notes.
sources.applicability: Supports conservative starting memory/thread limits and warns that engine memory_limit is not a full process-RSS cap.
sources.limits: The suggested settings are general documentation guidance, not measured or guaranteed settings for the proposed 16 GB workstation profile.

sources.title: DuckDB Python API documentation
sources.locator: Python minimum; direct CSV/JSON/Parquet query; Arrow/Pandas/Polars interop and result conversion; connection and global-thread-safety sections.
sources.applicability: Supports one embedded SQL engine in the Python worker, direct path queries, and explicit per-worker connections.
sources.limits: Documentation shows API behavior but does not show compatibility with the proposed notebook stack, sandbox, or 5 GB workload; version template on the page is not an exact wheel lock.
